title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Among discrete high-nuclearity 3d-4f clusters in the authors' CSD screen, iminodiacetic acid and its derivatives account for most structures once the metal count exceeds 50, and nearly all once it exceeds 100.
explanation: The authors collected 114 CSD entries with more than five lanthanide and more than five transition-metal centers, excluding extended frameworks such as MOFs. IDA-type ligands lead the distribution; their share is stated as about 80% above 50 metal centers and 93% above 100.
scope: Discrete 3d-4f clusters meeting the stated nuclearity cutoffs in the Cambridge Structural Database screen summarized in Fig. 3.
conditions: Screen criterion written as [Ln] > 5 and [TM] > 5, with continuous MOF-type structures excluded.
caveats: Percentages reflect this database filter and ligand classification, not a complete census of all 3d-4f compounds.
